title: In Transit

purpose.en: Two-step transfers that were shipped and are not received yet, with their age. Open one to receive it or to settle a difference.
purpose.id: Transfer dua langkah yang sudah dikirim dan belum diterima, beserta umurnya. Buka satu untuk menerimanya atau menyelesaikan selisih.

keywords: in transit, transit, dalam perjalanan, transfer dua langkah, two-step, ship, kirim, receive, terima, discrepancy, selisih, loss, return

steps.en: In Stock Transfer choose Transfer Type Two-step, add the lines, then click Confirm. Confirm ships: the stock leaves the source bin and sits in the In Transit bin.
steps.id: Di Stock Transfer pilih Transfer Type Two-step, tambah baris, lalu klik Confirm. Confirm berarti kirim: stok keluar dari bin asal dan ada di bin In Transit.

steps.en: Open this screen. The boxes on top filter In transit, Discrepancy, Received and Closed. Age counts the days since shipping.
steps.id: Buka layar ini. Kotak di atas menyaring In transit, Discrepancy, Received, dan Closed. Age menghitung hari sejak dikirim.

steps.en: Open a shipped transfer. For each line enter what really arrived and click Receive. The stock moves from In Transit to the destination bin.
steps.id: Buka transfer yang sudah dikirim. Isi jumlah yang benar-benar tiba untuk tiap baris lalu klik Receive. Stok pindah dari In Transit ke bin tujuan.

steps.en: If less arrived, the transfer becomes Discrepancy and the missing quantity stays in In Transit.
steps.id: Bila yang tiba lebih sedikit, transfer menjadi Discrepancy dan jumlah yang kurang tetap di In Transit.

steps.en: Settle each difference: Loss books it to the Loss bin, Return puts it back in the source bin. When all are settled the transfer is Closed.
steps.id: Selesaikan tiap selisih: Loss membukukannya ke bin Loss, Return mengembalikannya ke bin asal. Bila semua selesai, transfer menjadi Closed.

steps.en: A shipped transfer can be cancelled in Stock Transfer until it is received; the stock returns to the source bin.
steps.id: Transfer yang sudah dikirim bisa dibatalkan di Stock Transfer sampai diterima; stok kembali ke bin asal.

fields.label: Transfer No. / Route
fields.en: The transfer number and the source and destination warehouse codes.
fields.id: Nomor transfer dan kode gudang asal dan tujuan.

fields.label: Shipped
fields.en: When and by whom the transfer was shipped.
fields.id: Kapan dan oleh siapa transfer dikirim.

fields.label: Age (days)
fields.en: Days since shipping; for a received transfer, the days it took.
fields.id: Hari sejak dikirim; untuk transfer yang sudah diterima, lamanya perjalanan.

fields.label: Short Qty
fields.en: The quantity that did not arrive and is not settled yet.
fields.id: Jumlah yang tidak tiba dan belum diselesaikan.

fields.label: Received
fields.en: Per line, typed by the receiver. It cannot be more than the quantity sent.
fields.id: Per baris, diisi penerima. Tidak boleh lebih dari jumlah yang dikirim.

fields.label: Loss
fields.en: Books the missing quantity to the Loss bin. It stays in the books until a Stock Adjustment writes it off.
fields.id: Membukukan jumlah yang kurang ke bin Loss. Tetap ada di buku sampai Stock Adjustment menghapusnya.

fields.label: Return
fields.en: Puts the missing quantity back in the source bin of the line.
fields.id: Mengembalikan jumlah yang kurang ke bin asal baris itu.

title: Count Tasks

purpose.en: Stock counting by area. Starting a count makes a task for every item in the area's bins and locks those bins until they are counted.
purpose.id: Hitung stok per area. Memulai hitung membuat tugas untuk tiap item di bin area itu dan mengunci bin sampai selesai dihitung.

keywords: count, hitung, opname, stock opname, count lock, kunci bin, inventory count, cycle count, hitung stok, count tasks, selisih

steps.en: Choose an area under Start Counting and click Start Count. Areas marked due have passed their Count Every days in Storage Areas.
steps.id: Pilih area di Start Counting lalu klik Start Count. Area bertanda due sudah lewat hari Count Every di Storage Areas.

steps.en: Start Due Areas starts every due area at once. The command inv:count-due does the same and can be scheduled.
steps.id: Start Due Areas memulai semua area yang jatuh tempo sekaligus. Perintah inv:count-due melakukan hal yang sama dan bisa dijadwalkan.

steps.en: While a bin is locked, Stock Transfer, putaway and picking refuse it. Count the items physically.
steps.id: Selama bin terkunci, Stock Transfer, putaway, dan pick menolaknya. Hitung item secara fisik.

steps.en: Open a task, enter the Counted Quantity and click Confirm. A difference to the system quantity makes a Stock Opname document that is posted like any adjustment.
steps.id: Buka tugas, isi Counted Quantity lalu klik Confirm. Selisih terhadap qty sistem membuat dokumen Stock Opname yang diposting seperti adjustment lain.

steps.en: When every task of a bin is done or cancelled, the bin is unlocked.
steps.id: Bila semua tugas sebuah bin selesai atau dibatalkan, bin dibuka kembali.

fields.label: Area
fields.en: Chosen from the storage areas that are not virtual.
fields.id: Dipilih dari area penyimpanan yang bukan virtual.

fields.label: System Qty
fields.en: The stock card balance when the task was made.
fields.id: Saldo kartu stok saat tugas dibuat.

fields.label: Counted Quantity
fields.en: What was really counted. The difference is taken against the balance at the moment you confirm.
fields.id: Yang benar-benar dihitung. Selisih dihitung terhadap saldo saat Anda konfirmasi.

fields.label: Stock Opname
fields.en: The number of the opname document made for the difference.
fields.id: Nomor dokumen opname yang dibuat untuk selisih.

title: Send to Subcontractor

purpose.en: Sends our material to a subcontractor against an open Subcon PO. The stock moves to the subcontractor's virtual bin; it stays ours and keeps its value.
purpose.id: Mengirim bahan kita ke subkon atas PO Subkon yang terbuka. Stok pindah ke bin virtual subkon; tetap milik kita dan tetap bernilai.

keywords: subkon, subcon, subcontractor, kirim bahan, send material, po subkon, stock at vendor, bahan di vendor, jasa luar

steps.en: Click + New Record. Choose the Subcon PO and the material with its bin, then enter the quantity and the Due Back date.
steps.id: Klik + New Record. Pilih PO Subkon dan bahan beserta bin-nya, lalu isi jumlah dan tanggal Due Back.

steps.en: Click Send. The stock moves from the bin to the subcontractor's bin through a Stock Transfer. There is no journal.
steps.id: Klik Send. Stok pindah dari bin ke bin subkon lewat Stock Transfer. Tidak ada jurnal.

steps.en: When the subcontract receipt is confirmed in Procurement, the material is used at the vendor in the same share as the PO quantity received.
steps.id: Saat penerimaan subkon dikonfirmasi di Procurement, bahan tercatat terpakai di vendor sebanding bagian jumlah PO yang diterima.

steps.en: Open a send to settle by hand: Return brings unused material back to a bin, Used records it as used at the vendor (a normal stock out).
steps.id: Buka kiriman untuk menyelesaikan manual: Return membawa bahan yang tidak terpakai kembali ke bin, Used mencatatnya terpakai di vendor (stock out biasa).

steps.en: A send can be cancelled only while nothing was used or returned. Check what is still at the vendor in Stock at Vendor.
steps.id: Kiriman hanya bisa dibatalkan selama belum ada yang terpakai atau kembali. Cek sisa di vendor di Stock at Vendor.

fields.label: Subcon PO
fields.en: Only open purchase orders of type Subcontract are listed.
fields.id: Hanya PO bertipe Subcontract yang masih terbuka yang tampil.

fields.label: Material and Bin
fields.en: Raw material in a real bin with its quantity. Customer-owned stock cannot be sent.
fields.id: Bahan baku di bin nyata beserta jumlahnya. Stok milik customer tidak bisa dikirim.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.en: More than zero and not more than the bin holds.
fields.id: Lebih dari nol dan tidak lebih dari isi bin.

fields.label: Due Back
fields.en: When the result should be back. A send past this date shows Overdue.
fields.id: Kapan hasil harus kembali. Kiriman yang lewat tanggal ini tampil Overdue.

title: Stock at Vendor

purpose.en: Our material that is at subcontractors: sent minus used minus returned, with its age since sending.
purpose.id: Bahan kita yang ada di subkon: dikirim dikurangi terpakai dan dikembalikan, beserta umur sejak dikirim.

keywords: stock at vendor, bahan di vendor, subkon, umur, overdue, jatuh tempo, subcontractor stock

steps.en: Open the report. Each row is one material of one send that is not used up or returned yet.
steps.id: Buka laporan. Tiap baris adalah satu bahan dari satu kiriman yang belum habis terpakai atau kembali.

steps.en: Filter by Subcontractor. Overdue means the Due Back date has passed.
steps.id: Saring per Subcontractor. Overdue berarti tanggal Due Back sudah lewat.

fields.label: At Vendor
fields.en: Quantity sent minus used minus returned.
fields.id: Jumlah dikirim dikurangi terpakai dan dikembalikan.

fields.label: Age (days)
fields.en: Days since the material was sent.
fields.id: Hari sejak bahan dikirim.

title: Customer Material

purpose.en: Material that belongs to a customer and sits in our warehouse. It has no value, no journal, and is picked only for that customer's jobs.
purpose.id: Bahan milik customer yang ada di gudang kita. Tidak bernilai, tidak dijurnal, dan hanya di-pick untuk pekerjaan customer itu.

keywords: customer material, bahan titipan, titipan customer, consignment, bahan dari customer, stok milik customer

steps.en: In Procurement, make a Customer receipt and add the material lines (pick the raw material). Confirm it.
steps.id: Di Procurement, buat penerimaan Customer dan tambah baris bahan (pilih bahan baku). Lalu Confirm.

steps.en: The material goes into a bin of a Consignment area as stock owned by the customer. If no such bin exists, Confirm is refused.
steps.id: Bahan masuk ke bin area Consignment sebagai stok milik customer. Bila bin seperti itu tidak ada, Confirm ditolak.

steps.en: Open this report to see what each customer has in the warehouse, where, and how long.
steps.id: Buka laporan ini untuk melihat isi gudang milik tiap customer, di mana, dan berapa lama.

fields.label: Customer
fields.en: The customer who owns the material.
fields.id: Customer pemilik bahan.

fields.label: Bin
fields.en: The bin in the Consignment area.
fields.id: Bin di area Consignment.

fields.label: Last Movement
fields.en: The date of the last stock card row of this material in the bin.
fields.id: Tanggal baris kartu stok terakhir bahan ini di bin.
